AboutMe.title: About Me
AboutMe.bio1: Born in 1984 in Trabzon, Türkiye, he completed his primary education at Akçaabat Central Primary School and Ardeşen Cumhuriyet Primary School, and his secondary education at Rize Pazar Ahmet Tahtakılıç Anatolian High School.
AboutMe.bio2: After graduating from Ege University Faculty of Medicine, he completed his residency in Otorhinolaryngology at Ankara Training and Research Hospital.
AboutMe.bio3: He worked at Kırklareli State Hospital between 2014-2018, and at Kırklareli Private Doğuş Medical Center and Lüleburgaz Private Medikent Hospital between 2018-2023. Since 2023, he has been working in his private practice in Kırklareli.
AboutMe.bio4: He is married and the father of two daughters, Ada and Nil.

Rhinoplasty.title: A nose designed for your face, and for your breathing.
Rhinoplasty.intro: As an Otolaryngology Head and Neck Surgery Specialist, I plan every rhinoplasty around two goals: a natural result in harmony with your features, and a nose that works as well as it looks.
Rhinoplasty.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation for rhinoplasty.
Rhinoplasty.a1Desc: As an ENT surgeon, I evaluate the inside of your nose as carefully as the outside. When needed, structural problems such as a deviated septum are corrected in the same operation.
Rhinoplasty.a2Desc: The goal is not a new nose but the right nose for your face. Proportions, profile and skin type are assessed individually, so the result looks as if it has always been yours.
Rhinoplasty.a3Desc: Every plan starts with a detailed conversation about your expectations. You will know what is realistic for your anatomy before you travel.
Rhinoplasty.techTitle: The right technique for each nose
Rhinoplasty.techDesc: The technique is chosen after examination, according to your anatomy and goals.
Rhinoplasty.t1Desc: My primary approach. It gives full visibility of the nasal structures, allowing precise, controlled shaping of the tip and bridge.
Rhinoplasty.t2Desc: Ultrasonic instruments reshape the nasal bones with high precision while protecting the surrounding soft tissue.
Rhinoplasty.t3Desc: Performed in selected cases, through incisions inside the nose, when the planned changes allow it.
Rhinoplasty.journeyTitle: From first call to flying home
Rhinoplasty.j1Desc: We meet on a video call to discuss your goals, evaluate your nose together and answer your questions.
Rhinoplasty.j2Desc: You receive a treatment plan and package details, so you can organize your trip with confidence.
Rhinoplasty.j3Desc: After you arrive, you are examined in person and your pre-operative tests are completed.
Rhinoplasty.j4Desc: Your operation takes place at Lüleburgaz Özel Medikent Hospital.
Rhinoplasty.j5Desc: You are followed closely during your stay. On day 7, the splint and nasal packing are removed.
Rhinoplasty.j6Desc: Once the splint is removed, you can fly home. Follow-up continues online.
Rhinoplasty.i1Desc: Surgeries are performed at Lüleburgaz Özel Medikent Hospital, in the Thrace region of Türkiye.
Rhinoplasty.i2Desc: Plan for 7 days in Türkiye. By day 7 the splint and packing are removed and you are ready to travel.
Rhinoplasty.i3Desc: On request, we help arrange accommodation and transfers. These are not included in the package price.
Rhinoplasty.i4Desc: The clinic is in Kırklareli, close to the Bulgarian border and within driving distance of Istanbul.
Rhinoplasty.f1Q: How long do I need to stay in Türkiye?
Rhinoplasty.f1A: 7 days. The splint and nasal packing are removed on day 7, after which you can return home.
Rhinoplasty.f2Q: How does the online consultation work?
Rhinoplasty.f2A: It is a video call with me personally. We discuss your expectations, evaluate your nose and plan the next steps.
Rhinoplasty.f3A: Most procedures are performed with the open technique and piezo instruments; the closed technique is preferred in selected cases. The final choice is made after examination.
Rhinoplasty.f4Q: Can breathing problems be treated at the same time?
Rhinoplasty.f4A: Yes. As an ENT surgeon, I evaluate nasal function during planning, and problems such as a deviated septum can be corrected in the same operation.
Rhinoplasty.f5Q: Do you help with accommodation and transfers?
Rhinoplasty.f5A: Yes, on request. Accommodation and transfers are arranged separately and are not included in the package price.
Rhinoplasty.f6Q: When will I see the final result?
Rhinoplasty.f6A: The new shape is visible once the splint is removed, but swelling subsides gradually. The final result typically settles over about a year.
Rhinoplasty.finalDesc: Book an online video consultation to discuss your goals and receive a personal plan.
